heroHeadline: Day 475: AJK Assembly Elects Gilani as PM Amid PML-N Revolt; Ceasefire Holds Amid Diplomatic Freeze
heroSubtitle: August 28, 2026: The Azad Jammu & Kashmir Legislative Assembly convened to elect Barrister Iftikhar Gilani as the territory's 17th prime minister, capping a chaotic transition after Nawaz Sharif dropped his original nominee, AJK PML-N President Shah Ghulam Qadir, in Gilani's favour on August 27. Qadir and former AJK PM Raja Farooq Haider publicly objected, with Qadir vowing to boycott the vote and invoking Sharif's own 'Vote Ko Izzat Do' (respect the vote) slogan; PML-N's 32-seat coalition against PPP's 14 was enough to seat Gilani regardless. The transition follows PML-N's August 25 sweep of the assembly's speaker and deputy speaker elections and the August 24 swearing-in of the 12th Legislative Assembly, all shadowed by the JAAC reserved-seat reform protest movement that rights groups say has killed dozens since June, and by unfinished voting in seven Poonch/Sudhnoti constituencies. On the security front, India's NIA disclosed August 25 that its Pahalgam probe has identified a unified ISI command structure coordinating J&K and Punjab-based terror groups, building on the August 24 Chandigarh Babbar Khalsa IED-plot bust. The ceasefire holds at Day 475 with no LOC violations since May 10, 2025. Bilateral freeze remains comprehensive: no ambassadors, $0 formal trade, IWT 'in abeyance,' and Pakistan's airspace ban on Indian aircraft extended to Sept 24.
